title: carpesium nepalense var. nilagiricum
intro: Carpesium nepalense var. nilagiricum, commonly known as Nilagiri Meadowsweet, is a plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Nilagiri Meadowsweet include wound healing, pain relief, and the management of digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
